payload.rebuttal: fixed: My ordering helper accepted either attempt_opened or attempt_closed as a valid predecessor for a gate_result fact, so moving a closed attempt's gate_result facts to before its attempt_closed (but still after attempt_opened) satisfied the check. Rewrote the helper to require attempt_closed specifically whenever that attempt has one anywhere in the fact list, and attempt_opened only when it never closed. Verified the probe (gate_result facts emitted before attempt_closed) now fails.
